Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 71

“The person who abandons all desires and moves about free of longing, without possessiveness and without ego, attains peace.”

Three renunciations in one line, and the last is hardest — nirahankara, without the sense of being the one who acts and owns. Peace is described as what remains once that drops away.
